subject: AWS ACE registration & PDM/PSM handshake — OrbitCloud (APAC)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Shinobu Tanaka <s.tanaka@orbitcloud.jp>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 +0900
Subject: AWS ACE registration & PDM/PSM handshake — OrbitCloud (APAC)

Hi Shinobu,

Great speaking briefly last week — thanks again for taking time. We’d love to get OrbitCloud enrolled in the AWS ACE co-sell track so we can coordinate a joint GTM plan and secure co-sell support for the upcoming pilot. To make that happen we need a few items from your side and a short internal intro between your GTM lead and our PDM/PSM.

Quick ask: can you share the AWS Seller/ISV account ID and confirm the target launch region (you mentioned AP-NORTHEAST-1)? I’ve attached an intake sheet with the minimal fields to complete ACE registration. Once we have that, Marissa (our PDM) will submit the ACE intake and loop in the AWS rep.

Proposed next steps:
- OrbitCloud: fill intake sheet (attached) + provide AWS seller ID and contact for procurement
- Redwood: Marissa to file ACE intake; Ben to create joint opportunity in HubSpot; Kimberly to validate marketplace listing requirements
- Book 30m handshake with PDM (Marissa) and PSM (Ben) — suggested window Wed 6/9 10:00–11:00 JST or Thu 6/10 14:00–15:00 JST

I’m CC’ing Marissa, Ben, and Kimberly so they can pick up operational pieces. If those times don’t work for you, share alternatives.

Attachments: orbitcloud-ace-intake-sheet.xlsx, redwood-ace-playbook-apac.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Shinobu Tanaka <s.tanaka@orbitcloud.jp>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hiroshi Yamamoto <h.yamamoto@orbitcloud.jp>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 10:04:00 +0900
Subject: Re: AWS ACE registration & PDM/PSM handshake — OrbitCloud (APAC)

Vivek — thanks, and excited to work with Redwood.

We completed the intake sheet (attached) and our AWS Seller ID is 1234-5678-9012. Target launch region is ap-northeast-1 (Tokyo) and we’re aiming to pilot with three enterprise customers in August. Procurement timeline: we anticipate vendor onboarding by mid-July.

A couple of notes from our side:
- We will need help confirming marketplace listing packaging (single-tenant vs. multi-tenant) because a few pilot customers require VPC peering and stricter data residency controls.
- Our GTM lead (Hiroshi) is on copy and will handle contractual discussions.

Handshare times: Thu 6/10 14:00 JST works for us. Please send a calendar invite.

Regards,
Shinobu Tanaka
VP, Strategic Partnerships — OrbitCloud
s.tanaka@orbitcloud.jp
+81 90 1234 5678

--- Attached: orbitcloud-ace-intake-sheet.xlsx ---

Subject: Fwd: AWS ACE registration & PDM/PSM handshake — OrbitCloud (APAC)

Team — forwarding OrbitCloud’s reply and intake. Key context:
- AWS Seller ID: 1234-5678-9012
- Launch region: ap-northeast-1 (Tokyo)
- Pilot target: Aug (3 enterprise customers)
- Requirements: potential VPC peering / stricter data residency — please flag any listing packaging constraints

Please:
- Marissa: can you file the ACE intake and route to the AWS partner contact? Attach any additional intake fields you need.
- Ben: open the HubSpot opp (deal OC-2027-1193) and kick off joint opportunity template; add estimated ARR and pilot dates.
- Kimberly: validate marketplace SKU/packaging recommendations and confirm if a private listing is a better fit given VPC peering asks.
- Priyom: please prepare a short checklist for security/compliance artifacts they’ll need (SOC 2 evidence, data processing addendum, logging/audit export).

I’ll schedule the 30m handshake for Thu 6/10 14:00 JST and include OrbitCloud and AWS rep (once Marissa adds them).

Thanks — Vivek

Thanks Vivek / Shinobu — happy to own the ACE intake and run the PDM/PSM kickoff. I’ve taken the attached intake and started the ACE form. Next items from Redwood ops:
- I’ll need the AWS partner manager email (we can route via your AWS rep if you prefer)
- Kimberly and I will review the listing model; based on the VPC peering requirement I recommend we evaluate a private/paid listing SKU and note a managed-VPC offering in the listing description
- Priyom, please find the compliance checklist below and drop any missing artifacts in the shared folder: SOC 2 Type II report, DPA template, network diagram, and sample audit log export

I’ve created the HubSpot opportunity (OC-2027-1193) and added estimated pilot ARR: $175k ARR year-1 if pilot converts. Calendar: handshake scheduled Thu, 2027-06-10 14:00–14:30 JST — invite sent to all.

Links: HubSpot opp — https://hubspot.company/contacts/OC-1193; ACE intake draft — https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-orbit-ace-notes

I’ll submit the ACE registration as soon as we have the AWS PM email and the signed intake.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Product Delivery Manager (PDM), Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
